title: Former employee was a Havana syndrome victim

plain: Eric Hazeline, introduced on a podcast as a former director of the NSA (the US National Security Agency, which handles electronic spying and codebreaking), talked with podcast host Jesse Michels about Havana syndrome. That is the name for a set of unexplained health problems reported by US diplomats and intelligence staff. Hazeline says one of the people affected used to work for him and that he knows that person extremely well, which would put the problem very close to the top of American intelligence.
